questions.question: A person invested a total of ₹15,000 in two different schemes, X and Y. Scheme X offers 10% simple interest per annum, and Scheme Y offers 12% simple interest per annum. Correct calculation of investment in Scheme X.
Incorrect calculation of investment in Scheme X.
Incorrect calculation of investment in Scheme X.

questions.explanation: Let the amount invested in Scheme X be ₹x. Then the amount invested in Scheme Y will be ₹(15000 - x). Interest from Scheme X (SIx) = (x * 10 * 2) / 100 = x / 5.
